summary: Reitar Logtech Holdings Ltd, a Cayman-incorporated Hong Kong-based real estate operator listed in the US, filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice and proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting (the non-US analogue of a special shareholder meeting) to be held November 2, 2026. Shareholders will vote on a one-for-ten reverse share split consolidating each class A and class B ordinary share, plus a consequential charter amendment adopting new articles. The record date is October 1, 2026. No price, stake, advisor, or deal consideration is stated; the board recommends approval. Watch for Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance and proportional adjustment of ADSs.
